description.para: Maximum percentage error allowed between the actual baud rate generated using the specified clock and the desired baud rate.

briefdescription.para: Provides a stub handler that is the default handler.

detaileddescription.para: This handler is called if the application has not set a handler when interrupts are enabled. The function interface has to match the interface specified for a handler even though none of the arguments are used.

briefdescription.para: Initializes a specific XUartNs550 instance for use.

detaileddescription.para: The data format of the device is setup for 8 data bits, 1 stop bit, and no parity by default. The baud rate is set to a default value specified by Config->DefaultBaudRate if set, otherwise it is set to 19.2K baud. If the device has FIFOs (16550), they are enabled and the a receive FIFO threshold is set for 8 bytes. The default operating mode of the driver is polled mode.

parameterdescription.para: Reference to a structure containing information about a specific UART 16450/16550 device. XUartNs550_Init initializes an InstancePtr object for a specific device specified by the contents of Config. XUartNs550_Init can initialize multiple instance objects with the use of multiple calls giving different Config information on each call.

Device base address in the virtual memory address space. The caller is responsible for keeping the address mapping from EffectiveAddr to the device physical base address unchanged once this function is invoked. Unexpected errors may occur if the address mapping changes after this function is called. If address translation is not used, use Config->BaseAddress for this parameter, passing the physical address instead.

listitem.para: XST_UART_BAUD_ERROR if the baud rate is not possible because the input clock frequency is not divisible with an acceptable amount of error.

briefdescription.para: Sends the specified buffer of data using the UART.

detaileddescription.para: This function operates in either polled or interrupt driven modes. It is non-blocking such that it returns before the data has been sent by the UART. If the UART is busy sending data, it returns and indicates zero bytes were sent.

In a polled mode, this function only sends as much data as the UART can buffer, either in the transmitter or in the FIFO if present and enabled. The application may need to call it repeatedly to send a buffer.

In interrupt mode, this function starts sending the specified buffer and then the interrupt handler of the driver continues sending data until the buffer has been sent. A callback function, as specified by the application, is called to indicate the completion of sending the buffer.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to a buffer of data to send.
Number of bytes to send. A value of zero stops a previous send operation that is in progress in interrupt mode. Any data that was already put into the transmit FIFO is sent.

simplesect.para: The number of bytes actually sent.

The number of bytes is not asserted so that this function may be called with a value of zero to stop an operation that is already in progress.
This function and the XUartNs550_SetOptions() function modify shared data such that there may be a need for mutual exclusion in a multithreaded environment and when XUartNs550_SetOptions() is called from a handler.

briefdescription.para: Attempts to receive a specified number of bytes of data from the UART.

detaileddescription.para: This function stores received data into the specified buffer. It is designed for either polled or interrupt driven modes. It is non-blocking such that it returns if no data has already been received by the UART.

In a polled mode, this function only receives as much data as the UART can buffer, either in the receiver or in the FIFO if present and enabled. The application may need to call it repeatedly to receive a buffer. Polled mode is the default mode of operation for the driver.

In interrupt mode, this function starts receiving and then the interrupt handler of the driver continues receiving data until the buffer has been received. A callback function, as specified by the application, is called to indicate the completion of receiving the buffer or when any receive errors or timeouts occur. Interrupt mode must be enabled using the SetOptions function.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to buffer to receive data into.
Number of bytes to receive. A value of zero stops a previous receive operation that is in progress in interrupt mode.

simplesect.para: The number of bytes is not asserted so that this function may be called with a value of zero to stop an operation that is already in progress.

briefdescription.para: Sends the previously specified buffer using the instance variables.

detaileddescription.para: This function is designed to be an internal function for the XUartNs550 component such that it may be called from a shell function that sets up the buffer or from an interrupt handler.
This function sends the specified buffer of data to the UART in either polled or interrupt driven modes. It is non-blocking such that it returns before the data has been sent by the UART.

In a polled mode, this function only sends as much data as the UART can buffer, either in the transmitter or in the FIFO if present and enabled. The application may need to call it repeatedly to send a buffer.

In interrupt mode, this function starts sending the specified buffer and then the interrupt handler of the driver continues until the buffer has been sent. A callback function, as specified by the application, is called to indicate the completion of sending the buffer.

simplesect.para: NumBytes is the number of bytes actually sent (put into the UART transmitter and/or FIFO).

briefdescription.para: Receives a buffer previously specified by setting up the instance variables of the instance.

detaileddescription.para: This function is designed to be an internal function for the XUartNs550 component such that it may be called from a shell function that sets up the buffer or from an interrupt handler.

This function attempts to receive a specified number of bytes of data from the UART and store it into the specified buffer. It is designed for either polled or interrupt driven modes. It is non-blocking such that it returns if there is no data already received by the UART.

In a polled mode, this function only receives as much data as the UART can buffer, either in the receiver or in the FIFO if present and enabled. The application may need to call it repeatedly to receive a buffer. Polled mode is the default mode of operation for the driver.

In interrupt mode, this function starts receiving and then the interrupt handler of the driver continues until the buffer has been received. A callback function, as specified by the application, is called to indicate the completion of receiving the buffer or when any receive errors or timeouts occur. Interrupt mode must be enabled using the SetOptions function.

briefdescription.para: Sets the baud rate for the specified UART.

detaileddescription.para: Checks the input value for validity and also verifies that the requested rate can be configured to within the 3 percent error range for RS-232 communications. If the provided rate is not valid, the current setting is unchanged.
This function is designed to be an internal function only used within the XUartNs550 component. It is necessary for initialization and for the application-facing function that sets the data format.

parameterdescription.para: Baud rate to set in the hardware.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if everything configures as expected.
XST_UART_BAUD_ERROR if the requested rate is not available because there was too much error due to the input clock.

briefdescription.para: Required functions for the 16450/16550 UART driver.

detaileddescription.para: Refer to the header file xuartns550.h for more detailed information.
